short: Robert Bremer, C.Ht., C.R., offers hypnotherapy and reflexology with a focus on personal growth, relaxation, and wellness.
certs: Certified Hypnotherapist (C.Ht.); Certified Reflexologist (C.R.); professional member, American Hypnosis Association; Hypnotherapists Union Local 472.
training: Hypnosis Motivation Institute / HMI College of Hypnotherapy; Institute of Therapeutic Massage for reflexology training.
long: Robert Bremer is a certified hypnotherapist and certified reflexologist who offers individualized support for relaxation, personal growth, and wellness. Contact Robert to discuss his services and appointment availability.
